assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: premium automotive editorial website visualization.
Scene/backdrop: A clean brushed-concrete forecourt directly beside a prestigious independent Mercedes workshop. The architecture is black steel and floor-to-ceiling glazing, with an open industrial service hall and a quietly luxurious lounge visible behind the glass: warm walnut wall panels, tan leather seating and restrained warm linear lighting. Minimal architectural background, no exterior signs. The same understated workshop family across the collection.
Style/medium: extremely realistic automotive editorial photography, natural optical perspective, credible materials and reflections, finely resolved vehicle geometry, no synthetic showroom shine.
Composition/framing: landscape 16:9, approximately 1672 by 941 pixels. One whole stationary vehicle, tyres and all bodywork fully inside the frame, at least 10 percent clean breathing room on every edge. Vehicle is the dominant clear subject; tasteful slightly low camera, about 50mm full-frame lens. 
Lighting/mood: soft bright overcast daylight, calm understated luxury.
Color palette: subdued graphite, silver, black and warm walnut.
Constraints: generation-specific authentic production bodywork and ordinary factory wheels, no invented styling; blank unlettered number plates; no readable lettering, no headlines, no labels, no watermark. Mercedes three-pointed-star symbols may remain authentic. No people, no city clutter, no traffic, no secondary vehicle. This is a disclosed illustrative visualization, not evidence of a real customer job.
Subject: Silver Mercedes-Benz SLK R172, pre-facelift 2011–2015 production roadster, roof completely retracted, two seats and two roll-over hoops visible. Front three-quarter view. Correct R172 long bonnet, upright SLS-inspired single-blade grille with central star, angular single-unit headlamps, compact roadster proportions and short rear deck. Not the R171 pointed nose and not the later SLC facelift.
assets.subject: Silver Mercedes-Benz SLK R172, pre-facelift 2011–2015 production roadster, roof completely retracted, two seats and two roll-over hoops visible. Front three-quarter view. Correct R172 long bonnet, upright SLS-inspired single-blade grille with central star, angular single-unit headlamps, compact roadster proportions and short rear deck. Not the R171 pointed nose and not the later SLC facelift.
